response.justification: The candidate is a skilled and versatile software craftsman with a strong web/backend/mobile background, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no significant recent C++ experience (only a brief C/C++ stint in 2014-2015 for LabWindows/CVI), no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle expertise, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure beyond one fintech-adjacent role (RIDE Capital) that used Node/TypeScript rather than C++.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, pairing) and communication skills (talks, workshops)
Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up on new languages/domains (DLang, Swift, Java, etc.)
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience over a decade ago, far short of the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; background is Linux/cloud/web-centric
No SQL Server/Oracle experience and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain knowledge

key_factors.factor: No fixed income / capital markets domain expertise
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
